name: Shampoo
source: A martial artist from China who relentlessly pursues Ranma to make him her husband. Cursed at Jusenkyo, she transforms into a cat when splashed with water. Now, she runs the Chinese Cat Café, Nekohanten, alongside her great-grandmother Cologne.
